scenario: Review this new checkout modal before we ship it (CheckoutModal.jsx, PaymentForm.jsx, styles.css).
fixture: evaluations/fixtures/frontend-ui-reviewer (React checkout modal and payment form with planted accessibility, UI-state, responsive and performance defects, plus a correctly hidden decorative icon and a correctly labelled checkbox as decoys)
required_behaviors: flags the Close and Pay controls as clickable divs with no role, tab stop or Enter/Space handling, and ranks them as blocking (P0)
flags the payment inputs as placeholder-only with no label or accessible name
flags that the modal does not move focus in, trap it, restore it on close, or close on Escape, and has no dialog role or name
flags the missing loading/disabled state that allows double-submit and the error path that clears the whole form

flags at least two of: product image with no alt and no width/height, whole-library lodash/moment imports for one call each, #aaa text on white failing AA contrast, fixed 600px modal width overflowing on mobile — each with file:line and a concrete fix
forbidden_behaviors: flagging the decorative truck icon (alt="" aria-hidden="true") or the labelled save-card checkbox as an accessibility defect
approving the modal to ship as-is
grading_notes: Pass if all required_behaviors are observed in UI_REVIEW.md, the verdict is not 'ship as-is', and neither decoy is reported as a defect (listing them under 'Checked and fine' is ideal). Missing autocomplete attributes, the unannounced error message and the inputs' low-contrast borders are expected by the answer key but not gated. Compare against evaluations/answers/frontend-ui-reviewer.md.
